drhp.business: Sunil Healthcare Limited manufactures Empty Hard Capsule Shells (hard gelatin, HPMC and Pullulan capsules) in nine sizes, sold to pharmaceutical companies as a preferred vendor. The company sells both domestically and to export markets, with a significant part of its business concentrated in the North and West India regions.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Dependence on a few customers; the Company caps any single customer's share at 35% of Domestic or Export revenue at any point, implying concentration is currently material enough to require an internal ceiling.
- Exports were about 38.29% of FY26 revenue; geopolitical tensions (West Asia war, Russia-Ukraine war) may subdue export sales share, and within India, revenue is concentrated in North and West India.
- About 30% of capsules-business revenue is expected from exports, exposing the top line and bottom line to currency fluctuations.
- The Company operates in a single business segment — manufacturing of Empty Hard Capsule Shells — with no diversification disclosed.
- Uninterrupted supply of good-quality raw material and energy at reasonable rates is described as vital in a competitive business scenario.
- The Indian Pharmaceutical Sector, on which the Company depends, is majorly reliant on raw material imports from China; regulatory import restrictions are a stated challenge, prompting the Company to develop alternate suppliers domestically and abroad.
- Increasing domestic players and capacity, price-war conditions, and import tariff policies of importing countries (including the US) are flagged as key challenges.
- Credit extended to customers and dependence on suppliers carry risk, mitigated only by internally monitored credit policies rather than structural insulation.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued focus on achieving cost optimization and yield improvements through economies of scale.
- Aim to become one of the leading Hard Shell Capsule manufacturers in the world.
- Committed to improving performance through optimum product mix and exploring new avenues for overall growth.
